lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 8 high-contrast vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is irregular, with the widest gaps occurring at the anterior shoulder and posterior rump sections, and a higher density of lines clustered in the central torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple segments exhibit truncation; the second line from the posterior is significantly shorter than the primary lines, and two segments in the mid-torso terminate before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct white spots are located on the posterior lateral haunch, positioned in a cluster where two spots are vertically oriented above a third.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The visible right horn exhibits a spiral lyrate geometry, initiating posteriorly from the skull and curving dorsally/laterally with a distinct twist.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tip accounts for approximately 12-15% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white chevron between the eyes, white spots on the lower cheek, a long dark ventral fringe, and a prominent white dorsal mane/crest extending from the neck to the rump.
